record.title: In the LLM era, Word Sense Induction remains unsolved
record.scope_reason: The paper evaluates word-sense induction using SemCor-derived data and Wiktionary. It concerns lexical semantics and unsupervised disambiguation,not a biomedical domain-specific task.

record.title: Navigating the Political Compass: Evaluating Multilingual LLMs across Languages and Nationalities
record.scope_reason: The paper measures political ideology using the PoliticalCompassTest across multilingual models,languages and nationalities. This is political-bias evaluation,not medical or biomedical research.

record.title: Who Can Withstand Chat-Audio Attacks? An Evaluation Benchmark for Large Audio-Language Models
record.scope_reason: CAA evaluates robustness of audio-language models against audio attacks. Physical page4 derives samples from MELD,TVQA and CommonVoice and filters professional terminology and sensitive topics. Emotion labels and human hearing properties support a generic conversational robustness task,not clinical hearing or speech assessment.

record.title: Beyond the Tip of Efficiency: Uncovering the Submerged Threats of Jailbreak Attacks in Small Language Models
record.scope_reason: The study compares small-language-model jailbreak susceptibility and defenses. Physical pages3–4 use AdvBench,DAN,MaliciousInstruct,StrongREJECT and XSTEST across broad harmful-content categories. These are general model-security experiments,not medical safety evaluation.

record.title: EMRs2CSP : Mining Clinical Status Pathway from Electronic Medical Records
record.scope_reason: EMRs2CSP extracts clinical status pathways from electronic medical records. Physical pages5–6 specify400expert-reviewed breast-cancer records from a tertiary hospital,1127Huatuo breast-cancer QA examples,and evaluation of extraction,medicalQA and treatment-process decision support. The actual task and experiments are medical-primary;automatic metrics and LLM judgments do not establish clinical efficacy.

record.title: A Law Reasoning Benchmark for LLM with Tree-Organized Structures including Factum Probandum, Evidence and Experiences
record.scope_reason: The benchmark targets legal reasoning with factum probandum,evidence and experience for court decisions. It is legal AI,not biomedical research.

record.title: Libra: Leveraging Temporal Images for Biomedical Radiology Analysis
record.scope_reason: Libra generates radiology Findings from temporal chest X-rays. Physical pages5–6 specify MIMIC-CXR,Medical-Diff-VQA and MIMIC-Ext-MIMIC-CXR-VQA,frontal current/prior images,and radiology-specific evaluation. The study is medical imaging/report generation throughout.

record.title: Stereotype Detection as a Catalyst for Enhanced Bias Detection: A Multi-Task Learning Approach
record.scope_reason: StereoBias jointly learns bias and stereotype detection across religion,gender,socioeconomic status,race,profession and other social categories. The actual task is language fairness,not a clinical or biomedical assessment.

record.title: Filling the Temporal Void: Recovering Missing Publication Years in the Project Gutenberg Corpus Using LLMs
record.scope_reason: The work recovers publication years for ProjectGutenberg books using web,library and book-text sources. It is temporal metadata enrichment for historical linguistics and humanities,not biomedical literature mining.

record.title: ExpliCa: Evaluating Explicit Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: ExpliCa evaluates causal/temporal connective reasoning in ordinary English event pairs. Physical page4 describes then/after/so/because variants,lexical-association controls and crowdsourced acceptability ratings. It is linguistic reasoning,not clinical causality or psychological diagnosis.

record.title: Are Dialects Better Prompters? A Case Study on Arabic Subjective Text Classification
record.scope_reason: The paper studies Arabic dialect/script prompting. Physical page2 defines sentiment,emotion,irony and flood-crisis classification from social-media/review datasets. Emotion recognition and disaster messages are not clinical mental-health assessment;no biomedical-primary objective is established.

record.title: Natural Logic at the Core: Dynamic Rewards for Entailment Tree Generation
record.scope_reason: The paper uses natural logic rewards for entailment trees. Physical page5 evaluates EntailmentBank with ARC question-answer pairs and WorldTreeV2 leaf facts. General science reasoning is not biomedical-primary.

record.title: R.R.: Unveiling LLM Training Privacy through Recollection and Ranking
record.scope_reason: Recollect-and-Rank evaluates generic training-data privacy leakage. Physical page5 uses ECHR,Enron and LLM-PC PII datasets,not clinical-record reconstruction or a biomedical-primary task.

record.title: Nested-Refinement Metamorphosis: Reflective Evolution for Efficient Optimization of Networking Problems
record.scope_reason: NeRM applies biological metamorphosis as an algorithmic analogy for network optimization. The full abstracts evaluate TSP,MKP and CVRP routing/resource-allocation problems. It does not investigate biological systems or medical optimization.

record.title: MC-MKE: A Fine-Grained Multimodal Knowledge Editing Benchmark Emphasizing Modality Consistency
record.scope_reason: MC-MKE is generic multimodal knowledge editing. Physical page5 constructs data from MQuAKE factual triples with retrieved entity images and geography/sports examples. It is model consistency evaluation,not biomedical knowledge editing.

record.title: Visualising Policy-Reward Interplay to Inform Zeroth-Order Preference Optimisation of Large Language Models
record.scope_reason: ZOPrO is generic preference optimization. Physical pages3–4 use HH-RLHF for policy/reward dynamics;physical page8 evaluates Summarize-from-Feedback and WMT20 alongside conversational assistants. No biomedical-primary task is present.

record.title: AskQE: Question Answering as Automatic Evaluation for Machine Translation
record.scope_reason: AskQE is a general translation-quality framework whose actual study is biomedical-primary. Physical pages4–5 construct ContraTICO from COVID19 TICO-19 translations and evaluate BioMQM biomedical translation errors;footnote8 explicitly excludes general MT benchmarks to focus on high-stakes contexts,and language pairs are chosen for healthcare demand. Physical page8 compares error-severity judgments and accept/reject simulations on BioMQM. Inclusion is grounded in primary actual experiments,not an incidental medical example;the simulation is not a deployment validation.

record.title: Look & Mark: Leveraging Radiologist Eye Fixations and Bounding boxes in Multimodal Large Language Models for Chest X-ray Report Generation
record.reason: Look & Mark is primarily chest-X-ray radiology report generation. Pages 2–4 and 6–7 combine expert eye fixations and abnormality boxes using REFLACX/MS_CXR from MIMIC-CXR, with 560 images and 1,372 dictated reports; the research and evaluation center on clinically grounded report quality. Gains vary by model, so this is not uniform benefit or proven clinical deployment. Figure 1 explicitly substitutes a Wikimedia radiograph and paraphrases the report, rather than reproducing a MIMIC image.

record.title: Sign2Vis: Automated Data Visualization from Sign Language
record.reason: SIGN2VIS is explicitly disability-specific assistive accessibility for Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing users, rather than generic sign-language modeling with incidental health motivation. Pages 2, 8, 15–16 and 18 describe a sign-language visualization interface and a study of 15 DHH community participants. Crucial limitation: participants watched prerecorded translated task demonstrations and gave feedback; they did not directly operate the system, and the local sign-language dialect differs from ASL. Retain as a disability-accessibility candidate, without treatment or real-use efficacy claims; central scope review agrees.
